name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
description: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana is an accident insurance scheme that offers one-year accidental death and disability cover, renewable from year to year. The coverage is Rs. 2 Lakh for accidental death and full disability, and Rs. 1 Lakh for partial disability. The premium is Rs. 20 per annum, which is auto-debited from the subscriber's bank account.
eligibility: 1. All individual bank account holders. 2. Age between 18 and 70 years. 3. Consent to join and enable auto-debit of premium. 4. Account holders of participating banks are eligible.
documents: 1. Aadhaar Card 2. Bank Account Details (for auto-debit) 3. Consent cum Declaration Form 4. Mobile Number
steps: 1. Contact the bank or post office where your savings bank account is maintained. 2. Request the PMSBY application cum auto-debit consent form, or log in to your Net Banking portal. 3. Fill in your name, Aadhaar card number, nominee details, and select your savings account. 4. Tick the auto-debit consent box to allow the annual premium deduction of Rs. 20. 5. Submit the form online or hand it to the bank teller to activate your accidental insurance coverage.
